The purpose of the Financial Reporting Council (FRC) is to serve the public interest by setting high standards of corporate governance, reporting and audit and by holding to account those responsible for delivering them.
Our direct stakeholders include companies, institutional investors, auditors, actuaries, accountants and their respective professional bodies. Our indirect stakeholders include retail shareholders, suppliers, employees, customers, communities, pensioners and savers, and financial institutions, all of whom have an interest in the health of companies and other organisations within our existing and future regulatory scope and in the success of the UK corporate sector as a whole.
By agreement with DBT and HM Treasury, the FRC is funded partly through a levy on the following organisations that are subject to, or have regard to, FRC regulatory requirements in preparing their accounts:
• Companies listed on the London Stock Exchange, and UK AIM and AQUIS Market group companies with an equity share listing.
• Large private entities with a turnover of £500m or more. Subsidiaries of UK listed companies with a turnover of £500m or more are invoiced on the same invoice as their parent company.
• Standard Global Depository Receipt companies ('GDRs'). • Government Departments and other public sector organisations that publish accounts.

Procurement Overview: AI-Powered Translation Solution
Purpose:
We are seeking a qualified supplier to provide an Artificial Intelligence (AI) solution for accurate, efficient, and scalable translation services. This solution will primarily be used for translating documents and mandatory signage to support our organization's multilingual communication requirements.
Scope of Requirement:
The AI translation solution must be capable of:
Translating written documents (e.g., reports, manuals, instructions) across multiple languages.
Translating and localizing mandatory signage to meet regulatory and cultural standards.
Ensuring high levels of accuracy and contextual understanding in translations, particularly for technical, legal, and safety-related content.
Supporting commonly used file formats (e.g., PDF, DOCX, JPG for scanned documents).
Integrating into our existing document management systems, if applicable.
Mandatory Features:
AI-driven translation engine with support for at least 10 major global languages.
OCR (Optical Character Recognition) functionality to translate scanned or photographed documents.
Customizable glossaries or translation memory features to maintain consistency across translations.
Data privacy and compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR).
User-friendly interface or API for internal team access.
Evaluation Criteria:
Translation accuracy and contextual relevance.
Ease of integration and user interface quality.
Service scalability and turnaround times.
Pricing model and total cost of ownership.
Supplier experience and customer support capabilities.
